dedupe_keys.name: ipe deploiement fibre optique par immeuble

description: IPE - Déploiement fibre optique par immeuble is a dataset listed in Hérault Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. Ce jeu de indique détaille l'éligibilité à la fibre pour chaque immeuble présent sur territoire héraultais, mis à jour tous les mois. Dès que l’état d’avancement des travaux le permet, les opérateurs chargés du raccordement des immeubles à la fibre optique renseignent un fichier d’échange, l’IPE pour « Informations Préalables Enrichies ». Coverage: Hérault. The portal files it under Territoires, Agriculture et Innovations. Its keywords are fibre, tres-haut-debit, IPE, raccordement, ftth. The portal shows 490,210 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-herault-data-fr-portal.
